dog.description_text:
Max and Milo are bonded brothers looking for a home where they can stay together. These sweet boys can be a little shy when you first meet them, but give them some time and they’ll warm up and show you just how loving they are. They’re both feeling a little nervous in the shelter environment, and we can’t wait to see them settle into a home where they can feel safe, comfortable, and loved. With each other by their side and a family to call their own, we know Max and Milo will make wonderful companions.

If this animal is located at our Manhattan Adoption Center, head in to meet them and see if you are a match! We are a same-day adoption center, and an application does not put you on a list or hold an animal for you. If they are in Wantagh or in a foster home, please submit an online application and our team will reach out to further discuss the adoption process. Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped, and given their age-appropriate vaccines.
